subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should ScopeTree become a public incremental Plugin SDK contract before all bundled group-policy callers have migrated, or remain internal until one canonical path can replace the existing resolver?
rationale: The choice determines the permanent external plugin contract, deprecation obligations, and whether staged or consolidated landing is acceptable; code review alone cannot choose that API direction.

options.title: Keep ScopeTree internal
options.body: Migrate bundled callers and remove the competing resolver before exposing the final narrow SDK contract.

options.title: Approve incremental public API
options.body: Document and compatibility-test both paths while staged channel migrations complete under an explicit deprecation plan.

options.title: Consolidate the landing
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106846 as the canonical branch after it resolves the same findings and supplies real-channel proof.

recommendation.title: Keep ScopeTree internal
recommendation.body: Migrate bundled callers and remove the competing resolver before exposing the final narrow SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The related ScopeTree design, staging, and consolidation history centers on this person's config and Plugin SDK work.
